title: Soy Sat’s march from Phnom Penh toward Poipet for social justice
reason: An actual march with domestic social/political demands is documented, but RFA reports he began alone and about six people were walking alongside him on 7 March; this does not meet the 50-person threshold.
notes: The opened sources do not establish a later crowd of 50 or more. Do not count the prior February CITA march or union/party affiliation as March participants. End date remains unknown; exclusion is based on no qualifying-sized gathering in observed reporting, not claim that the march did not occur.

title: Youth activists gather outside the Thai Embassy on International Women’s Day
reason: RFA reports about 20 Cambodian youth activists; the gathering is below 50 and their demand was addressed to the Thai government, not Cambodia’s government or policy.
notes: Separate from the announced 500-person Freedom Park event. Do not use the AP photo credit as evidence for the separate celebration’s attendance or written-story origin.
